a: Record Every act on every layer, by a person or an agent, in one trail.

p: The graph records assertions — an entity, a relation, a value, who said it and when it was so — and never overwrites one. A read takes two instants: as_of for when the world was so, as_known for how much had been heard. So a past answer can be reproduced exactly, and a correction does not erase what was believed before it. Each org’s own data lives in its Base, a SQLite store of its own.
Operations on api.hanzo.ai. One key reaches every layer.

table: Asserts what is true of an entity.
Reads the assertions the org has recorded, bounded by as_of and as_known.
What is in force about an entity as of an instant, and what disagreed.
What came into force, was superseded and was retracted between two instants.
Answers a question from the whole graph, citing the assertions it rests on.
Lists every Base the caller can reach, one per org.
